summary: Two open threads closed today. Walmart confirmed its Q3 release for 11-19, so the held WMT print is now a company-confirmed date 4 trading days out. Jensen Huang has resigned from Nvidia (Colette Kress is interim CEO), nine banks cut NVDA targets, and Nvidia reports 11-17, 2 trading days out, which keeps index-concentration risk high for QQQ, VOO and VTI. Crypto broke lower again: BTC fell below $69K with ETH and XRP about -6% and more than $1B liquidated, but no exchange failed. The holdings otherwise have no 8-K, 10-Q or 10-K in the 7-day window; DPZ got a Baird upgrade. Per L2 every symbol in the input is covered below, with each date checked against its own estimate and filings.

event_risk.why: Held. Company-confirmed now: 'Walmart Announces Third Quarter Earnings Call Date' (fiscal.ai, 11-12) puts the release and call on 11-19. That matches the file estimate (last year + 364 days) and closes the open-date question flagged 11-10 to 11-12. It is 4 trading days out (11-16, 17, 18, 19), so it is high risk for any add. PT drift keeps building: Wells Fargo raised to $135 from $120 today, after BofA $139, Baird $140, Gordon Haskett $130, BTIG $140, UBS $149, JPMorgan $145, BMO $136 and Mizuho $135 in the last week. That is nine or more raises in five sessions, so the bar for the print is high. No filings. The PM's L7 note still applies: a close-based stop does not protect against a gap on the print.

The Huang thread that began 11-09 has resolved into a resignation. Kress is interim CEO, and Trump publicly floated Tim Cook. NVDA fell as much as 14.3% on 11-12 and closed about -5%, and the Nasdaq 100 actually turned green as AMD and Broadcom rallied. Nine banks cut NVDA targets; Evercore went to $186 from $465. Nvidia reports 11-17 (11-11 Benzinga 'Nov. 17 earnings'), 2 trading days out. It is the index's largest AI weight, and its first print under an interim CEO is the dated catalyst. Futures were mixed to slightly up this morning (Polymarket 55% for a higher open), and ETF inflows were $37.5B in five days with VOO and QQQ leading. Caveat from my graded record: QQQ high flags from 10-30 to 11-04 graded wrong at 5 days in four of five cases. Read this as event risk around a dated print, not as a direction call.

A fourth leg down. After $75K broke on 11-09, it slid to $73K after CPI (11-10), fell below $72K/$73K on the Nvidia report (11-12), and is now below $69K overnight. More than $1B in liquidations, ETF outflows, and Iran tensions after Trump said 'we don't need a deal with Iran'. The 11-10 'Can Bitcoin hold $70,000' level has been lost, so the 11-11 and 11-12 downside warnings played out again. The MSCI removal of Strategy (confirmed 11-12) is still weighing; MSTR fell 6-7%. Exchange-failure clause: untripped. The FBI's report of a $400M North Korean deepfake-call theft targets individuals and Web3 professionals, not an exchange, and the TSMC ransom-in-BTC item is irrelevant. Bullish items (Adam Back $1M by 2028) are opinion. Not known whether a BTC position is still live after the ~11-09 sale; if it is, the PM must compute the mark against its stop.
Fell with BTC (about -6% with XRP, per the 11-13 'Bitcoin Implodes to $69,000' piece). No ETH-specific event; the same rates, ETF-outflow and Nvidia drivers apply.

No VOO-specific event. Nvidia is the S&P's largest weight; its CEO has resigned and it reports 11-17, 2 trading days out. VOO led the $37.5B five-day ETF inflow (dip-buying), which is flows, not an event. Treasury yields jumped again on 11-12. Iran rhetoric is a new geopolitical overhang, although oil eased this morning.

The only new datum is that 'Treasury yields jumped' on 11-12 (Nasdaq-100 recap); no level is given. The next dated catalyst is the 12-09 FOMC, outside the window. Unchanged from 11-12.

New: gold fell to a one-year low, below $4,000, on 11-12 ('Gold Stocks Dip', 'Gold Falls Below $4000'). Benzinga attributes it to fading Middle East peace hopes; a rising-yield, hike-pricing backdrop also weighs on a non-yielding asset. I raised this from low because the move is a regime-level break for the sleeve, not an event with a date. The file's 11-24 'earnings' date is a data artifact for an ETF.

That is a bolt-on relative to an approx. $29B market cap, so it is not a 'large' 1.01 on its face. No 8-K in the window yet. Next 2027-02-25.

notable.headline: Walmart Announces Third Quarter Earnings Call Date (November 19, 2026)
notable.read: This closes the date question flagged since 11-10: the estimate was right, and 11-19 is now company-confirmed, 4 trading days out on a held name. Together with today's Wells Fargo raise to $135, the pre-print sentiment is crowded bullish. The PM asked on 11-12 for a one-third trim before the print; this confirmation removes the 'date unverified' excuse either way.

notable.headline: Wall Street Takes the Chainsaw to Nvidia Targets: One Bank Slashes $465 to $186; Nasdaq 100 Turns Green Despite Nvidia's 5% Drop on Huang Exit
notable.read: The 11-12 succession report escalated to a resignation within a day, so that flag came true. The index absorbed it: NVDA recovered from -14.3% to about -5% and the Nasdaq 100 closed green, with AMD and Broadcom bid. The dated risk is now Nvidia's 11-17 print under an interim CEO, which hits the QQQ, VOO and VTI sleeves through concentration.

notable.headline: Bitcoin Implodes to $69,000, Ethereum, XRP Down on ETF Outflows, Nvidia Turmoil
notable.read: This is the fourth leg since 11-09 ($75K, then $73K, then $72K, now below $69K), and the $70K level that Benzinga framed on 11-10 has gone. The drivers are rates, ETF outflows, the Nvidia shock, Iran and the Strategy index removal. No exchange failed, so a qualitative exchange-failure clause stays untripped. My BTC flags graded mixed at 5 days (right 11-04 and 11-06, wrong 11-02 and 11-03), so treat this as risk-watch, not a forecast.

notable.headline: Gold Stocks Dip: What's Going On? (gold at a one-year low); Nvidia Crisis ... Gold Falls Below $4000
notable.read: This is the first gold-specific move in the window, and it breaks a big round number. The cited cause is fading Middle East peace hopes. A gold sleeve, if held, is not behaving as a geopolitical hedge this week. That is one observation, not graded evidence.

notable.headline: Baird Upgrades Domino's Pizza to Outperform, Raises Price Target to $400
notable.read: A rating upgrade on a held name. It is the first fresh sell-side catalyst since the unconfirmed 10-30 guidance-cut item, which I closed as having come to nothing on 11-11. It is supportive and does not change event risk (next print 2027-02-22).

notable.headline: Deutsche Bank Downgrades CVS Health to Neutral, Cuts PT to $104 from $116
notable.read: This continues the 11-10 and 11-12 thread (Argus $105, Wells Fargo $112). It is now a rating cut, not just PT trims, so negative revisions after the print are broadening. It is a trend rather than an event. Not known to be held.

notable.headline: EMCOR To Acquire P1 Construction In All-Cash Deal; P1 Expected To Generate 2026 Revenue Of $600M-$650M, Adj. EBITDA Of ~$60M
notable.read: A bolt-on of roughly 4% revenue scale relative to EME, all cash, closing Q1 2027 with the price undisclosed. It is a modest integration and leverage item, not a thesis change. Watch for an 8-K 1.01 if the price turns out to be material.

notable.headline: Loop Capital Upgrades Autodesk to Buy, Announces $310 Price Target
notable.read: A supportive rating change 7 trading days before the estimated 11-24 print. If ADSK is proposed, it enters the 5-day high-risk window on 11-17.

notable.headline: 8-K item 5.02 filed 2026-11-12 (no headline)

notable.headline: Nasdaq 100 Turns Green ... while AMD and Broadcom rallied and Treasury yields jumped
notable.read: Yields rose again on 11-12, two sessions after the hot CPI, on a day equities held up. That repeats the 11-10 and 11-12 pattern the Market Analyst noted, with bonds weak while stocks were steady or up. No new dated rates event before the 12-09 FOMC.
